description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Mecânico industrial C
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos em busca de um MECÃNICO INDUSTRIAL C para a região de LIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.

#VemSerAgropalma


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e/ou corretiva em compressores de ar, trocadores de calor, sistemas de vapor e condensado, bombas centrifugas, helicoidais e dosadoras;
  • Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;
  • Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;
  • Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.


Instrução

  • Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;


Desejável

  • NR-35, NR-33;
  • Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.


Localidade

  • Limeira/SP
  • Americana/SP


Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.


Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).


Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.

  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);

description:

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: .Net AWS Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior .NET Developer with AWS experience to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the quick serve restaurants industry.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


Working hours: Pacific Time Zone . You will be required to follow the client's time zone.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Responsibilities :

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications using .NET in an AWS environment, and related technologies.
  • Develop and maintain back-end applications using ASP.NET, Web APIs, etc.
  • Integrate third-party services and APIs into internal applications
  • Ensure high-quality code by writing automated tests, performing code reviews, and adhering to best practices


Requirements:

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • Strong understanding of .NET Core and Web APIs , along with knowledge of AWS.
  • Proficient in C#, with experience building backend services (.NET framework)
  • Hands on experience in AWS environments (Azure is a plus)
  • The client expects the developer to have a very good understanding of AWS features and tools such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, EKS, Kubernetes , etc.
  • Experience supporting an integration and transformation platforms between internal systems and external vendor systems, especially those involving complex business logic.
  • Azure : Having knowledge in this area would be a bonus
  • Understanding of the QSR (fast food) industry : This is also considered a plus.
  • Good Understanding of OAuth and webhooks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience of working in a Agile environment

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo de cada cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Onboarding (1º mês)
  • Um mês de imersão para você conhecer em profundidade nossos processos, ferramentas, cultura, soluções e a rotina estratégica do assessor na EQI.
  • Afinamento Comercial (2º mês)
  • Aqui você entra em um treinamento intensivo de vendas, prospecção e qualificação, aprendendo a gerar grandes oportunidades de negócio.
  • Captação e Estruturação (3º e 4º meses)
  • Além de seguir prospectando, você inicia a captação de recursos e a estruturação de carteiras, adquirindo experiência prática e recebendo, ao final, uma base de clientes para gestão e relacionamento.
  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter ótimo relacionamento com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;
  • Estar constantemente atualizado sobre cenário macroeconômico, bem como oportunidades de mercado e produtos financeiros;
  • Assessorar e acompanhar constantemente a carteira de investimentos do cliente com foco em seus objetivos;
  • Saber gerenciar seu funil de vendas no CRM, com foco em levantar forecast e redução de ciclo comercial para atingimento de metas.



O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

• Fit Cultural;

• Certificação CPA-20, CEA ou CFP;

• Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);

• Perfil comercial e relacional;

• Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);

• Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).


Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia
  • Feedbacks estruturados
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais)
  • Partnership



Informações adicionais


Benefícios:

Salário + PPR Anual

VA/VR de R$ 1.812

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.

title: Linguist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing (Language: Portuguese, Location: Brazil)

Experience Level: Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Linguistics or a related field.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.

Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.


Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil

A International Schools Partnership está comprometida com a segurança e o bem-estar de crianças e jovens. Todos os profissionais devem cumprir processos rigorosos de verificação de antecedentes referentes aos últimos 10 anos de experiência.


Compromisso com Diversidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento

A International Schools Partnership promove uma cultura inclusiva e acolhedora, contratando e desenvolvendo talentos independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, deficiência, neurodivergência ou origem socioeconômica. Encorajamos candidaturas de profissionais que compartilham nossos valores e desejam contribuir para o sucesso da organização.

description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. You will be responsible for replying via the text message system with our warm leads on time, booking them into appointments, making phone calls, and asking a few qualifying questions. The company may offer growth opportunities depending on performance.

Requirements:

  • Strong English skills, a neutral accent, and familiarity with American culture.
  • Commitment to working 8:30am – 5.00pm New York Time.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Passion for digital marketing and a hunger to learn.
  • Experience in marketing or fitness is a bonus, but not required.

What We Offer:

  • Enjoy long-term stability and 100% remote.
  • Join a supportive team.
  • Get top-notch training in marketing and beyond.
  • Starting at $600/month with performance bonuses as you grow.

  • Growth Opportunities and Full Training

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em .NET utilizando C#.

- Desenvolver e manter interfaces web utilizando JavaScript, Angular, React, HTML/CSS.

- Desenvolver e manter queries SQL para manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais

- Realizar testes unitários e integração contínua

- Trabalhar em equipe em um ambiente ágil utilizando Git e JIRA

- Demonstrar proatividade, resiliência e adaptabilidade no ambiente de trabalho

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento com a linguagem C# .

- Sólido conhecimento em .NET Core/5/6+ e/ou .NET Framework .

- Proficiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful (Web API).

title: SRE - brazil
description:
Decskill, founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company, places paramount importance on its greatest asset: its people. Our main mission is to deliver value through knowledge and talent, and we achieve this by fostering a culture of excellence and investing in the development and well-being of our people. With over 600 dedicated professionals and offices in Lisbon, Porto, Madrid, and Luxembourg, Decskill operates across three core areas:


  • Decskill Talent: We believe that our people are key to our success. Through Decskill Talent, we empower our team to embrace the digital transformation challenges of our clients. We collaborate with clients to drive innovation, ensuring project success and business growth.


  • Decskill Boost: Equipping our team with the latest tools and methodologies, we optimize Time-to-Market and deliver innovative solutions exceeding client expectations.


  • Decskill Connect: Our team collaborates closely with clients to implement and manage IT infrastructures that generate long-term value.


At Decskill, we believe that by nurturing and empowering our people to confront the challenges of digital transformation, we create value not only for our clients but also for our entire ecosystem, fostering a digital community dedicated to growth and progress.


We are looking for an SRE to join us on a remote project in Brasil.


Responsabilities:

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and managers to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maximize the capabilities of our Azure platform for business applications.
  • Continuously evolve and enhance our identity management systems.
  • Prioritize the observability of our Azure environments.
  • Maintain cost efficiency and FinOps control of the platform.
  • Implement SRE and DevOps practices with a focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and implement new features to foster a CI/CD mindset, optimizing the software development lifecycle from development to production.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents, ensuring they do not recur.
  • Implement code review and testing mechanisms to continuously improve quality.
  • Ensure robust security practices are integrated into all aspects of the infrastructure and identity management systems.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on Azure.
  • Apply best practices for security, compliance, and operational efficiency across all systems.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Azure and its ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with identity management technologies, particularly Azure Active Directory and EntraID.
  • Solid understanding of observability best practices, particularly in Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in using code management tools and repositories.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, particularly with Terraform.
  • Strong autonomy and critical thinking skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, listening, and speaking), a collaborative mindset, and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluency in English (mandatory).


Additional/Preferable Skills

  • Proficiency in using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with security frameworks and best practices in cloud environments.
  • Certified Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification.


If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference DA/SRE


Decskill is committed to equality and non-discrimination with all our talents. We recruit and promote talent, based on diversity and inclusion, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, race, nationality or any other form of discrimination incompatible with the dignity of the human being.

  • Decskill Talent: We believe that our people are key to our success. Through Decskill Talent, we empower our team to embrace the digital transformation challenges of our clients. We collaborate with clients to drive innovation, ensuring project success and business growth.


  • Decskill Boost: Equipping our team with the latest tools and methodologies, we optimize Time-to-Market and deliver innovative solutions exceeding client expectations.

At Decskill, we believe that by nurturing and empowering our people to confront the challenges of digital transformation, we create value not only for our clients but also for our entire ecosystem, fostering a digital community dedicated to growth and progress.


We are looking for an SRE to join us on a remote project in Brasil.


Responsabilities:

  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and managers to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maximize the capabilities of our Azure platform for business applications.
  • Continuously evolve and enhance our identity management systems.
  • Prioritize the observability of our Azure environments.
  • Maintain cost efficiency and FinOps control of the platform.
  • Implement SRE and DevOps practices with a focus on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and implement new features to foster a CI/CD mindset, optimizing the software development lifecycle from development to production.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents, ensuring they do not recur.
  • Implement code review and testing mechanisms to continuously improve quality.
  • Ensure robust security practices are integrated into all aspects of the infrastructure and identity management systems.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on Azure.
  • Apply best practices for security, compliance, and operational efficiency across all systems.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Azure and its ecosystem in a production environment.
  • Familiarity with identity management technologies, particularly Azure Active Directory and EntraID.
  • Solid understanding of observability best practices, particularly in Azure environments.
  • Proficiency in using code management tools and repositories.
  • Experience with public cloud platforms.
  • Expertise in Infrastructure as Code, particularly with Terraform.
  • Strong autonomy and critical thinking skills, with a focus on collaboration.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, listening, and speaking), a collaborative mindset, and a proactive attitude.

Additional/Preferable Skills

  • Proficiency in using GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Strong knowledge of observability stacks, including monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML)
description:
About the company:


Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Remote : Contract


The Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing) plays a crucial role in the development and deployment of innovative machine learning solutions for retail pricing that includes understanding various customer and operational business constraints and translating complex real-world problems into well-defined mathematical objectives


✅ Minimum Requirements: - PhD or Masters degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operation Research or related field - 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning, 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale

- Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design

- Proficiency with scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas, polars) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (ScikitLearn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)

- Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets

- Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)

- Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure - Fluency in Python, SQL

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.


About the role:

As a Clinical trainer, reporting to the Clinical Training Director, you will be responsible for the development and deployment of clinical training for Lumenis customers, distributors and field employees. This position also involves overseeing every detail of training logistics to guarantee smooth and successful training sessions.


Main Duties:

  • Collaborate closely with the Clinical Training Director to implement and uphold rigorous high quality standards in training
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential customers (digital and onsite).
  • Provide clinical training to existing and potential distributors’-affiliated clinical trainers and follow-them up
  • Coordinate all local clinical events.
  • Demonstrate use/ benefits of Lumenis products to the customers.
  • Proactive involvement with the new changing needs of digital engagement.
  • Ensure that all training programs meet the required regulations and standards.
  • Innovate the current educational offering for salesforce and customers to a digital platform.
  • contribute to the global effort in producing collaterals such as but not limited to blog, newsletter, application notes etc


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience or training in the medical device industry; preferable experience in the aesthetics field - an advantage.
  • Experience in preparing and adjusting clinical presentations as per audience and allocated time.
  • Accurate in delivering training messaging.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Must be willing to travel throughout LATAM region – around 70%. and exceptionally outer LATAM
  • Interpersonal skills and professional demeanor.
  • Results- driven and self-motivated.
  • Highly organized and detail oriented.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Cooperate with others, teamwork.
  • Enthusiastic about gaining new knowledge and dedicated to self-improvement by regular engagement in professional development activities (such as but not limited to gathering clinical updates from scientific journals)
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese will be considered an advantage

title: Scrum Master
description:
Contract Duration: 6 to 12 months

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor / Contract

Work Model: Nearshore – Remote

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EST)


About the Opportunity

We are a staffing and recruitment consultancy supporting one of our clients with a long-term project. We are seeking a Scrum Master to join a Product & Engineering environment, supporting one to two Scrum teams and contributing to the continuous improvement of Agile practices.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for a professional who is comfortable working with distributed teams and collaborating closely with Agile leadership.


Experience Level

Mid-level (2–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master)


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies, ensuring alignment with Agile principles
  • Support and guide one Scrum team, with potential responsibility for a second team
  • Partner with an enterprise Agile Coach to improve team performance and delivery
  • Assist with the implementation and adoption of SAFe practices
  • Identify, escalate, and help remove impediments impacting team progress
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through experimentation and feedback
  • Work closely with mid-level managers and cross-functional team members across multiple regions


Required Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience as a dedicated Scrum Master
  • Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Scrum of Scrums)
  • Familiarity with SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework); certifications are a strong plus
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and navigate team conflicts
  • Experience working with distributed, global teams


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork mindset
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities
  • Adaptability, flexibility, and a proactive attitude
  • Ability to challenge ideas constructively and negotiate pushback when needed
  • Independent thinker with a continuous improvement mindset


Education & Certifications

  • SAFe certification is highly desired
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (optional)


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
  • Comfortable collaborating with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and evolve within Agile frameworks

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).
  • Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).
  • Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Security:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).

DevOps and Monitoring:

  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.

title: Account Executive
description:
The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.


About Us


Publicity For Good (PFG) is a Nashville-based public relations company that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands around the world.


We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.


At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth.


We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role

The Account Executive is responsible for managing the success of client PR campaigns by developing media strategies, conducting targeted outreach, and maintaining regular communication with both clients and media contacts. This role ensures client visibility across national, regional, podcast, radio, and TV platforms, while also contributing to broader brand awareness and engagement. Account Executives are key relationship builders and storytellers who drive results by connecting the right narrative to the right outlet.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute strategic PR plans tailored to each client
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Build, grow, and create new client relationships
  • Conduct media research and Build and update targeted media lists
  • Secure, filter, and respond to media opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate media interviews, ensuring all logistics are handled
  • Follow up with media contacts to confirm placements and coverage timelines
  • Monitor coverage through Google Alerts and track mentions or product features
  • Facilitate writing projects with team in alignment with client goals and deliverables
  • Monitor news trends and identify timely angles for client exposure
  • Provide daily (Monday–Friday) client updates and maintain consistent communication
  • Prepare and send biweekly and monthly reports and lookbooks
  • Maintain updated media trackers to record media coverage and interview status


Results


  • Meet or exceed the expected number of interviews or media features
  • Clients receive timely and proactive communication on campaign progress
  • Media placements align with client goals, increase brand visibility, and credibility
  • Clients recognize value from their engagement with Publicity For Good
  • Accurate and updated documentation of all PR activities and client deliverables


Requirements


  • 40 hours plus per week to meet client needs
  • Proven experience or education in public relations or a related communications field
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficient in Google Suite, Gmail, and media monitoring tools
  • Creative and strategic thinker with a proactive mindset
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first team environment
  • Personable and professional in client and media interactions
  • Able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
  • High level of self-accountability and commitment to delivering results


Remuneration & Rewards


  • Access to internal and external learning opportunities
  • Ongoing performance reviews and career development guidance
  • Clear advancement plan based on both role progression and financial growth
  • Access to a curated library of on-demand professional development content


The starting pay for this position is $693/m USD.

description:
