Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX); criação e manutenção de SSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC; criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 07 às 19h

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Product Owner– AI-Powered Platform
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Product Owner of an AI-Powered SaaS Solution, you will lead the delivery and integration of AI and automation capabilities across a suite of SaaS products. This role bridges product strategy with execution—translating business needs into technical requirements and ensuring that AI-driven features deliver measurable value. The ideal candidate will coordinate closely with data science, engineering, and product teams to build scalable, high-impact AI solutions that enhance user experience and business performance.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Drive the execution and delivery of AI-powered features, use cases, and platform capabilities across multiple SaaS products;
  • Translate business and product team requirements into actionable technical stories and sprint deliverables for data science and engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional squads to embed AI and automation into existing product workflows (e.g., recruiting, onboarding, performance, learning, analytics, and public safety);
  • Define and manage the product backlog for AI feature delivery, striking a balance between immediate priorities and long-term platform scalability;
  • Develop execution roadmaps, milestones, and release plans for model training, integration, and deployment across multiple product lines;
  • Track key performance indicators (velocity, cycle time, release quality, adoption metrics) to ensure continuous improvement in delivery efficiency;
  • Oversee post-deployment validation, ensuring model accuracy, reliability, and user experience alignment.


Essential Skills

  • Proven experience managing AI/ML-driven product initiatives within SaaS environments;
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies and end-to-end product lifecycle management;
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business terms;
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics and measure adoption and performance;
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams (engineering, data science, product, and UX).


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with machine learning model lifecycle management—from concept to deployment;
  • Familiarity with AI integration in enterprise SaaS systems, including automation, natural language processing (NLP), and predictive analytics;
  • Understanding of MLOps, model monitoring, and continuous improvement practices;
  • Ability to balance innovation with scalability and compliance requirements.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.

Noções de vetores, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais;


Compreensão de APIs, microservices e conceitos básicos de cloud;


Boa capacidade de depuração, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica;

Familiaridade com plataformas de cloud.

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, \"mostly right\" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a \"big picture\" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

· Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

· Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

· Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

· Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

· Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills

Experiência sólida com Node.js e desenvolvimento de APIs Domínio de .NET (C#) e ASP.NET Core e Node ,conhecimento avançado em Angular (preferencialmente versões 20)

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.

description:

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. A TM Digital é a divisão tecnológica da TerraMagna responsável por levar todas as nossas inovações para o mercado. Nossa jornada começou com a tecnologia, identificamos os desafios comuns do agronegócio e expandimos para o financiamento graças à nossa expertise em gestão de riscos em tempo real, um reflexo da nossa solidez tecnológica. Nosso propósito é fortalecer a cadeia de distribuição de insumos e transformar a maneira como o crédito é concedido e recebido no agronegócio brasileiro. Por isso, dividimos a credibilidade tecnológica que permitiu a TerraMagna se tornar o que é para o mercado agro.

A tecnologia está no centro do que fazemos. Nossas equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura de sistemas, banco de dados, experiência do usuário, cibersegurança e data & analytics atuam em conjunto para construir o sistema operacional do agronegócio. description:
Team Leader

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.




Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?


Garantir a entrega de valor ao cliente por meio da gestão integrada de pessoas, processos e relacionamentos, promovendo o desenvolvimento das pessoas, a eficiência operacional e a geração de novas oportunidades de negócio.


Como será seu dia a dia?


  • Acompanhar a performance das pessoas junto ao Cliente
  • Apoiar o(a) Delivery Manager (DM) nas atividades do dia a dia e nas decisões relacionadas ao time e ao cliente. (Acompanhar KPIs; Prestar suporte à área técnica com análises e percepções sobre desempenho; ferramentas como Sólides, sistemas de apropriação e service desk.)
  • Apoiar o(a) Delivery Manager (DM/GPM) na elaboração de planos de ação relacionados à pesquisa de NPS
  • Facilitar cerimônias e eventos com o time para garantir a integração
  • Promover reuniões com os Clientes para gerar novos negócios e benchmarking
  • Identificar riscos e propor soluções para manter o atendimento de qualidade das pessoas alocadas.
  • Fomentar o desenvolvimento profissional das pessoas, aplicando boas práticas..
  • Atuar na resolução de conflitos e na motivação da equipe para alcançar altos níveis de desempenho.
  • Garantir a comunicação e relacionamento eficiente entre stakeholders, clientes e equipe.
  • Coletar feedbacks das lideranças do cliente sobre os colaboradores alocados
  • Realizar reuniões de feedback com os liderados e registrar nas ferramentas internas
  • Estruturar Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) junto aos liderados, visando não apenas o aumento de performance e produtividade, mas também o desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional do liderado.
  • Entender tanto o negócio quanto os produtos do cliente, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e propondo melhorias para fortalecer a entrega de valor.
  • Realizar acompanhamento de aprovações de férias, banco de horas, atestados médicos e folgas, além do apontamento de horas e ponto.
  • Monitorar e analisar regularmente indicadores financeiros da operação, identificando áreas de melhoria e ajustando estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance e indicadores gerais para conhecer as métricas do time
  • Levantar, junto aos clientes, as necessidades de novas demandas e alocação de profissionais
  • Acompanhar, junto aos líderes de áreas de RH, o processo seletivo de novos profissionais para o time
  • Conduzir os ritos de Onboarding e alinhamentos iniciais com informações sobre o contexto que os profissionais irão atuar na Rethink.
  • Realizar a movimentação dos profissionais caso aconteça mudança/saída do contexto de atuação
  • Promover encontros recorrentes com as áreas (Engenharia, Produto, Design, Qualidade, Delivery) para favorecer a integração entre os times e o desenvolvimento das skills comuns



O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?


Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo



Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?


  • Inscrição
  • Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  • Bate-papo com People
  • Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: SR Backend Developer - Kotlin / Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Aproxime-se. A Invillia não apenas transformou a forma como as empresas mais revolucionárias do mundo criam e desenvolvem estratégias, negócios e produtos digitais.

Inovou também a maneira como pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia, de qualquer lugar do planeta, podem interagir, evoluir, mais conectados do que nunca.

Para a Invillia, não importa onde você está. Se é um país grande. Ou uma cidade pequena. E sim a sua vontade. As suas ideias. O seu potencial.

O tamanho do seu talento_


Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional será responsável em prover soluções técnicas para novas features e dar o suporte necessário as features já existentes, afinal, nem tudo são flores.

Esperamos também que essa pessoa auxilie os outros membros do time em questões técnicas não esquecendo de fornecer a melhor solução para o negócio.

Algo que prezamos bastante é qualidade, isso inclui um código limpo e legível (clean code).

Também é desejável que o mesmo tenha um perfil intra-empreendedor, onde seus objetivos estejam alinhados com os objetivos da empresa, afinal, temos muito orgulho do que fazemos aqui!


Requisitos e qualificações

Como Desenvolvedor Back-end Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento e evolução da plataforma do cliente dentro de uma squad multidisciplinar.

O papel envolve não apenas o desenvolvimento de novas features e produtos, mas também a definição de soluções técnicas estratégicas, garantindo que o software seja robusto, escalável, seguro, performático e de alta qualidade. Também será responsável por compartilhar conhecimento e nivelar o expertise técnico dentro da squad, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e evolução contínua.

Responsabilidades:

* Desenvolver e integrar soluções em parceria com fornecedores e times externos, alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do cliente.

* Projetar e implementar componentes de alta complexidade, garantindo resiliência, performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

* Atuar com autonomia na entrega de soluções em cenários com múltiplas dependências e ambientes distribuídos.

* Promover boas práticas de engenharia, elevando a maturidade técnica do time e fortalecendo a cultura de qualidade.

* Definir e monitorar métricas que aprimorem governança, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão orientada a dados.

* Liderar incidentes críticos, direcionando a investigação, correção e análise de causa raiz.

* Otimizar custos e performance das aplicações, garantindo sustentabilidade e eficiência do ecossistema.

* Suportar o time em desafios técnicos complexos, fomentando inovação e melhoria contínua.

* Conduzir code reviews, mentorias e compartilhamento de conhecimento para desenvolvimento técnico da equipe.

Requisitos:

* Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software em arquitetura Cloud Native.

* Experiência com Cloud Computing, especialmente AWS.

* Domínio das linguagens Kotlin (principal) e Java.

* Experiência com Microservices, APIs REST e Arquitetura Event-Driven.

* Sólido conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e arquitetura de solução.

* Experiência com Containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

* Vivência em testes automatizados (unitários, integrados e de carga).

* Proficiência em paradigmas de programação, boas práticas, design patterns e Clean Architecture.

* Experiência com serviços de mensageria e cache.

* Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.

Diferenciais:

* Experiência no setor de IGaming, incluindo jogos e plataformas disruptivas.

title: Senior AEM Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior AEM Developer


Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior AEM Developer to work on the project that manages all the institutional pages of a client's domain in the insurance sector, as well as lead capture forms and product acquisition flows (Insurance, Banking, Services).


This professional will work on the end‑to‑end development and maintenance of AEM solutions—components, templates, integrations, and support for the Java BFF layer—within a modern architecture that integrates AEM, Next.js, Adobe Commerce, and an AWS Serverless middleware (Carbon).


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including components, models, templates, and pages.
  • Implement and maintain the Java BFF layer running on serverless architecture.
  • Create and maintain custom administrative dashboards within AEM CMS.
  • Integrate AEM with multiple corporate APIs, ensuring security, performance, and stability.
  • Collaborate with React/Next.js teams for visual and structural integration (preferred).
  • Work closely with architecture, backend, and middleware teams to ensure technical consistency.
  • Analyze technical impacts and propose improvements for scalability, performance, resilience, and user experience.
  • Provide technical support for Adobe Commerce, Carbon middleware, and AWS serverless integrations.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, refinement sessions, and technical discussions.
  • Lead complex technical analyses and mentor less‑experienced developers.


Technical Requirements


  • Senior‑level experience with Adobe Experience Manager 6.x+ :
  • Component, model, template, and page development
  • Sling Models & OSGi
  • HTL templating
  • AEM Sites / AEM Author
  • Strong expertise in Java , ideally with serverless architecture.
  • Experience with REST API integrations, authentication, security, and data handling.
  • Knowledge of performance tuning and caching strategies for AEM.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git/GitFlow.
  • Ability to work within complex architectures (AEM + Middleware + APIs + Front‑end).
  • Experience with cloud environments (preferably AWS ).


Preferred Technical Competencies


  • Knowledge of React and collaboration with frontend teams.
  • Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Commerce (Magento) for cart/checkout flows.
  • Experience with microservices or event‑driven architectures.
  • Experience with logging, monitoring, distributed tracing.


Behavioral Competencies


  • Strong analytical capability and autonomy in technical decision‑making.
  • Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Systemic thinking to operate across integrated architectures (AEM + BFF + Middleware + Commerce).
  • Proactivity in problem-solving and risk identification.
  • Organization and discipline in documentation and execution.


Skill Set Summary


  • AEM 6.x+ (components, Sling, OSGi, Sites, dispatcher basics)
  • Java (serverless, REST APIs, architectural patterns)
  • AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, serverless services)
  • Git/GitFlow
  • Corporate API integrations
  • Basic understanding of React/Next.js
  • Knowledge of security, monitoring, logging, and performance best practices

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label SaaS architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Consultor Técnico - GWS
description:
Quem somos?


Somos parceiros estratégicos de nossos clientes na jornada de transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras para a implementação de tecnologias em nuvem. Com o apoio do nosso time de especialistas, auxiliamos na migração para ambientes em nuvem, modernização de aplicações, segurança de dados, serviços gerenciados e práticas de FinOps eficientes.


Se você tem paixão por tecnologia, busca inovação e acredita no poder da colaboração, temos a oportunidade ideal para você como Consultor Técnico de GWS.


O seu papel será:

  • Planejar e executar migrações de dados complexas (Exchange, O365, IMAP, etc. para GWS)
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos detalhados (assessments) nos ambientes dos clientes, identificando lacunas de segurança, oportunidades de otimização de licenças e melhorias de fluxo de trabalho.
  • Configurar políticas avançadas de segurança (DLP, Context-Aware Access, Vault, SSO/SAML, Gerenciamento de Dispositivos/MDM).
  • Desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas administrativas e relatórios (GAM, Apps Script, APIs do Google).
  • Atuar como ponto focal para resolução de incidentes críticos (Nível 3), troubleshooting de e-mail (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) e problemas de sincronização.
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança (Trusted Advisor) para os clientes, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em configurações técnicas no GWS.


Para participar desse processo seletivo, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com Google Workspace: Admin Console, Vault, Mobile Management (MDM)
  • Experiência com protocolos SMTP, DNS, Roteamento de e-mails, SPF, DKIM e DMARC
  • Experiência comprovada em migrações complexas (cenários híbridos, dual delivery)
  • Experiência com GAM / GAMADV-XTD3 (Linha de comando) é essencial para automação e gestão em massa
  • Conhecimento em Google Apps Script, APIs do Google e noções de GCP (Identity Platform)
  • Inglês Intermediário (leitura técnica e abertura de chamados com Google Global são rotina)
  • Certificação Associate Google Workapce Administrador (Obrigatório)

Responsabilidades

  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture , Hooks , componentização e testes unitários .

O que oferecemos
