title: Head of School
description:
This role will be located in a school in Brazil; it is not remote


As International Schools Partnership increases its presence across Brazil, we are seeking Principals, Aspiring Principals, and Senior Leaders with strong K-12 experience and a track record of driving whole-school improvement. This is an opportunity for leaders who are passionate about Academic Excellence and who bring an operational and commercially minded approach to running high-quality schools.

Join a global network committed to empowering school leaders, encouraging innovation, and positively shaping learning communities throughout Brazil.

About International Schools Partnership

International Schools Partnership is a leading and growing group of 114 private international schools operating in 25 countries and educating over 92,500 students worldwide.

Our role is to support and enable our schools to become the schools of choice in their local communities and the global education sector. We strive to grow schools renowned for setting new standards of excellence in education, cultivating future-ready students and enriching the communities they serve.

Why choose International Schools Partnership to be your career of choice?

  • Global Outlook: Lead in an environment that promotes cultural awareness and international collaboration.
  • Commitment to Excellence: Join a group dedicated to delivering high-quality teaching and learning.
  • Modern Learning Environments: Work in innovative and well-resourced facilities designed for progressive education.
  • Leadership Growth: Benefit from continuous professional development and global leadership pathways.


Purpose of Role

The Principal leads with vision and integrity, fostering a safe, inclusive, and supportive school culture where learning thrives. By working collaboratively with their team, parents, and the wider International Schools Partnership network, they position the school as a “School of Choice” that delivers exceptional learning experiences and outcomes, translating into increased enrolment growth and higher student retention. Their responsibilities span safeguarding, driving teaching quality through evidence-based improvement, strategic planning, community engagement, and commercial performance. Parents/carers and students recognise and endorse the school for academic excellence, and teachers’ professional learning and development thrives under their stewardship of the school. The Principal reports to the Regional Managing Director (RMD).

Key Responsibilities

All sections are weighted equally at 25% from a performance perspective.

  • People Development and Wellbeing
  • Student Learning Outcomes
  • Grow Community and Deliver Exceptional Customer Service and Experience
  • Commercial Success


Key Skills

Strategic planning

Educational leadership

Safeguarding and Child Protection management

Inclusive leadership

Emotional intelligence

Building community

Stakeholder engagement

Team development

Performance management

Engaging communication

Data-driven decision-making

Marketing insights

Financial acumen

Change management

Collaborative mindset

Commitment to Safeguarding Principles

International Schools Partnership is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.

Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

International Schools Partnership is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of International Schools Partnership through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: ANALISTA RELAÇÕES COM INVESTIDORES SR.
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


Qual será sua missão?


  • Tem como responsabilidades o atendimento às exigências dos órgãos regulamentadores do Mercado de Capitais no Brasil, preparação de relatórios trimestrais com o resultado da Companhia, manutenção e atualização do site de Relações com Investidores da Companhia, atendimento aos analistas buy side e sell side, bem como atendimento aos investidores e potenciais investidores da Companhia;

description:

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira & transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.


Sobre a vaga

Você será responsável por liderar a direção de arte dos projetos de Branding da HIKE traduzindo estratégia de marca em sistemas visuais fortes, consistentes e aplicáveis no mundo real. Na prática, você é quem puxa a régua de qualidade do design, conduz rotas criativas, refina soluções até o nível máximo de acabamento e garante entregas impecáveis de design.


Nível do cargo

Sênior


Responsabilidades


  • Direção de arte de marcas: Liderar o desenvolvimento de sistemas visuais (identidades e key visuals), transformando insumos de estratégia (posicionamento, arquitetura, territórios, tom) em soluções visuais claras, proprietárias e autênticas.


  • Criação e evolução de identidades: Criar identidades completas (logo, paleta, tipografia, patterns, ilustrações, linguagem fotográfica e motion guidelines quando aplicável) e evoluir marcas existentes com consistência.


  • Packaging e design de key visuals: Desenvolver e/ou direcionar projetos de embalagem e key visuals.


  • Exploração criativa: Conduzir rotas criativas com clareza e repertório, testando caminhos antes de “fechar” a solução.


  • Padrão de craft: Ser referência de acabamento (tipografia, composição, hierarquia, cor, grid, micro detalhes), elevando o nível do time.


  • Gestão do time e/ou freelas: Direcionar e revisar entregas do time e/ou freelas, garantindo coerência com o sistema e nível de craft.


  • Feedback e iteração: Organizar rodadas de revisão (interno/cliente), filtrar feedback, priorizar ajustes e conduzir refinamentos sem perder o conceito.


  • Apresentação e defesa: Apresentar rotas e soluções com argumentação, critério e segurança; conduzir alinhamentos visuais e direcionar decisões.


Requisitos:

  • Portfólio robusto com projetos de branding (identidades e key visuals).
  • Experiência em conduzir rotas criativas e refinar soluções.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Adobe CC).
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de sistemas visuais.
  • Capacidade de traduzir estratégia de marca em decisões visuais (para além da estética).
  • Experiência em apresentar e defender trabalho para clientes, gerindo feedbacks com maturidade.

title: Tech Lead .NET Core
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56624


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.
  • Domínio de React.js , Hooks , Context API , e boas práticas de componentização.
  • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)


  • Arquitetura:
  • Experiência comprovada com microserviços e event-driven architecture .
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiencia com integração com sistemas


  • Cloud (AWS):
  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.

  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement

  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

title: Software Engineer
description:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.

As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: SASE Network Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Job Title: Senior SASE Network Engineer

Location: Latham

Duration: 1+ Year


Role Description:

The Senior Network Engineer, SASE will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for all SASE-related technologies, driving the network and security transformation from traditional, perimeter-based models to a secure, cloud-centric architecture. This role involves integrating core SASE components—such as SD-WAN, Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)—to deliver secure and high-performance access for all users, regardless of location. Join us to tackle challenging projects and make a direct impact on our core product while investing in your professional growth.


This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be located in Bengaluru, India. At Client, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Design and Architect highly available, scalable, and secure SASE solutions for complex, global, and hybrid-cloud network environments.
  • Lead the implementation and deployment of core SASE components, including SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and DNS security solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize security policies, routing, and traffic steering logic across the SASE platform to enforce a consistent security posture.
  • Evaluate and integrate new SASE-related technologies and features to maintain a state-of-the-art security and networking stack.
  • Drive Zero Trust principles by designing and implementing fine-grained, identity-centric access control policies (ZTNA).
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools to increase deployment speed and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Cyber Security teams to ensure SASE policies and configurations align with organizational security standards and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in network and/or security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on SASE or similar cloud security architectures.
  • Expert knowledge of SASE Framework and its core components (SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, FWaaS).
  • Extensive hands-on experience with major SASE vendor solutions (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access, Fortinet, Cisco/Meraki).
  • Deep understanding of Network Protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Proficiency in Cloud Networking and security principles in one or more major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong Scripting and Automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible) for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Familiarity with Network Security concepts such as Next-Generation Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS inspection, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)



Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Python, YAML
  • Jira, Confluence
  • Ansible automation

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.



Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Understand how to use a web browser console log in the debugging process
  • Understanding of Public/Private IP addresses and Domain names
  • Understanding what a Firewall does
  • What does a Proxy Server do
  • Understanding of the basics of SSO


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: SAP ABAP Developer
description:
Job Title: SAP ABAP Developer

Brazil (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled SAP ABAP Developer to join our team for a strategic spin-off initiative. This role involves designing, developing, and maintaining custom SAP applications and enhancements to support the separation of business units and ensure seamless system functionality during and after the transition.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain custom ABAP programs, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and forms (RICEF).
  • Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Support data migration, system integration, and cutover activities related to the spin-off.
  • Optimize and troubleshoot existing ABAP code to ensure performance and reliability.
  • Participate in unit testing, debugging, and documentation of technical specifications.
  • Ensure compliance with SAP development standards and best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in SAP ABAP development.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP SD module.
  • Experience with ALV reports, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, SmartForms, Adobe Forms, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced project environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in spin-off related SAP projects.
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori/UI5 development.
  • Exposure to SAP PI/PO or CPI integration tools.
  • Agile or hybrid project methodology experience.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of mechanical & manufacturing
description:
Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work. Please read the recruitment requirements carefully. Thank you.


WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 30 papers in SCIE/SSCI/AHCI journals in the past five years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance
  • Dentrix

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

Location: Remote

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role -LLM - Full Stack Python + JS

Project duration: 3 Months

Exp - 3+ Years

Skill - Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript

Availability - 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.


Role Overview :

We’re a coding-focused team at Turing that serves as a research partner for a Frontier AI Lab. Our role is to build coding tasks, evaluations, datasets, and tooling that help train and improve large language models (LLMs).

You’ll write and debug production-quality code, design rigorous evaluations, and build reproducible workflows that generate clean, high-signal data for model training. Attention to detail matters deeply here—small mistakes can cascade into misleading results, so precision and thoroughness are essential. You’ll also collaborate closely with engineers, researchers, and quality owners to align on standards, review work, and continuously raise the quality bar.

If you enjoy solving unusual technical problems, investigating subtle model failures, and working in developer-like environments where correctness, reproducibility, and collaboration matter, this role will keep you very entertained.


What does your day-to-day look like :

  • Write, review, and debug code across multiple languages
  • Design tasks and evaluation scenarios for coding, reasoning, and debugging
  • Investigate LLM outputs and identify hallucinations, regressions, and failure modes
  • Build reproducible dev environments using Docker + automation tools
  • Develop scripts, pipelines, and tools for data generation, scoring, and validation
  • Produce structured annotations, judgments, and high-quality datasets
  • Run systematic evaluations that help improve model reliability and reasoning

Required Skills :

  • Experience using LLM coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, CodeWhisperer)Strong hands-on coding experience (professional or research-based) in one or more of:
  • Python, JavaScript / Node.js, TypeScript
  • (Additional languages like Go, Java, C++, C#, Rust, SQL, R, Dart, etc. are a plus)
  • Solid experience with Linux + Bash, scripting, and automation
  • Strong with Docker, reproducible environments, and dev containers
  • Advanced Git skills (branching, diffs, patches, conflict resolution)
  • Solid understanding of testing and QA (unit, integration, negative, edge-case focused)
  • Ability to reliably overlap with 8am–12pm PT

title: Cientista de Dados Senior (IA)
description:
Descrição do cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior AI / ML Engineer para liderar o desenvolvimento e a implantação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning em escala. Essa pessoa será protagonista na construção do nosso ecossistema de IA, atuando com GenAI, NLP, visão computacional, entre outros, com impacto direto em produtos, processos e decisões estratégicas da empresa.

Propósito da posição


Você será responsável por transformar dados em decisões inteligentes, liderando frentes técnicas e estratégicas com foco em inovação, eficiência e impacto real no negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos, integrações e fundações de ciência de dados e IA, trabalhando em colaboração com áreas envolvidas.
  • Propor, construir e acompanhar soluções fim a fim: desde o mapeamento da necessidade, proposição e desenho de solução, exploração do dados, treinamento, produtização e escala do modelo, análise e monitoramento dos seus resultados, além do acompanhamento do seu ciclo e consumo, garantindo pontos de condução ética e legal.
  • Evoluir o ecossistema de Data & AI para que esteja saudável, atualizado e à frente do mercado, com construção conjunta com áreas parceiras como Arquiteturas, Engenharias de Aplicações, Sustentação, Negócios e Riscos.
  • Estabelecer, guiar e avaliar melhores prática, capabilities, engines, aceleradores, padrões e frameworks em cases e soluções técnicas,
  • Avaliar, aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de governança, ética, justiça, explicabilidade, segurança e compliance em modelos de IA.
  • Conduzir e estabelecendo um grande Centro de Excelência habilitador de jornada com responsabilidade.
  • Criar parcerias e manter proximidade com Big Techs, alianças e universidades criando programas e laboratórios como parte evolutiva do ecossistema.
  • Colaborar ativamente com Data Strategy alinhada ao Business Strategy e tendências de mercado, construindo a visão de business x technical capabilities.
  • Contribuir em frentes culturais com o propósito de educar, capacitar, conscientizar, além de elevar o nível de maturidade em dados e IA na organização


Técnicas

  • Desenvolver e operacionalizar modelos de IA e ML em ambientes de produção.
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados e ML com foco em escalabilidade e governança.
  • Atuar com modelos supervisionados, não supervisionados, GenAI, NLP, LLMs e sistemas de recomendação.
  • Monitorar e ajustar modelos em produção para garantir performance e acurácia.

Estratégicas e culturais

  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas e contribuir para a visão de IA na companhia.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de IA responsável (fairness, explicabilidade, compliance).
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com arquitetura, produto, dados e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar a formação de um CoE de IA e promover a maturidade analítica da organização.
  • Conectar a estratégia de dados com a estratégia de negócio.

Stack técnica

  • Linguagens: Python (obrigatório), SQL
  • Bibliotecas: Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers (Hugging Face), OpenAI, Llama LLM
  • MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Airflow, CI/CD

Plataformas: Databricks, Azure (preferencial), AWS ou GCP

  • Bancos: Delta Lake, SQL, NoSQL
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado
  • 5+ anos de experiência com ciência de dados e IA em produção
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas de ML/IA
  • Experiência com MLOps, deploy de modelos e monitoramento
  • Conhecimento em modelos generativos (LLMs, embeddings & orchestration, prompt engineering)
  • Experiência com pipelines em cloud (preferencialmente Azure/Databricks)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa e gerenciar múltiplas prioridades.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de referência de governança de IA (envolvendo pontos como Responsible AI, AI Fairness).

Diferenciais

  • Compartilhar o GitHub ou qualquer outro repositório de portfolio para conhecermos seu trabalho
  • Experiência com time series, recomendação e modelos de visão computacional
  • Atuação prévia em CoEs ou iniciativas de IA Corporativa
  • Pós-graduação, certificações ou publicações relevantes

Se você quer trabalhar com IA de verdade, com liberdade para inovar e gerar impacto, essa vaga é pra você!!!

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: UX/UI Designer (E-Commerce Growth, CRO & A/B Testing)
description:
UX/ UI Designer – Swissker

Salary: USD $2,500 – $3,500/month

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time


About Swissker

Swissker is a US-based DTC e-commerce brand specializing in healthcare products that improve everyday wellbeing. We are a fast-growing company powered by data-driven decision-making, ongoing optimization, and a culture of experimentation.

Our focus is on creating high-performance funnels and product experiences that scale across multiple traffic sources and international markets.


Role Overview

We are looking for a UX Designer with strong experience in crafting high-converting user experiences for e-commerce. You will be responsible for designing funnels, advertorials, landing pages, PDPs, checkout flows, and other conversion-focused experiences used in A/B testing and continuous optimization.

You’ll collaborate with CRO, Marketing, Design, and Development teams to deliver clean, modern, and scalable Figma designs that directly impact revenue and KPIs.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design conversion-focused product pages, landing pages, funnels, advertorials, and checkout experiences in Figma.
  • Design versatile graphic assets for use across web pages, advertising creatives, and marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency and high visual impact.
  • Work closely with CRO Manager to turn hypotheses into testable UX/UI variations.
  • Create wireframes, high-fidelity layouts, UI components, and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with Developers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of designs.
  • Participate in experiment planning, UX reviews, and data-driven improvement discussions.
  • Analyze insights from A/B tests (preferable) and iterate on winning concepts.


Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX/UI Designer in web or e-commerce environments.
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, auto-layout, variants, and prototyping.
  • Proven experience designing web pages, especially e-commerce or funnels.
  • Portfolio is mandatory (web projects, landing pages, funnels, product pages, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, highly structured environment.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to follow processes and documentation standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in CRO, A/B testing, or experimentation-driven teams.
  • Experience creating graphic design assets for web experiences, digital ads, and marketing campaigns.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools, user behavior tools, and funnel analytics.
  • Experience in direct-response design or healthcare/e-commerce niches.
  • Strong understanding of UX heuristics and behavioral psychology.


Data Analysis is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD
  • Work in a highly data-driven environment with fast testing cycles
  • Opportunity to directly influence revenue and performance
  • 100% remote and flexible work environment
  • Growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding global DTC brand

Ideal Profile

  • Credible network among colocation buyers and AI/HPC stakeholders; comfortable at C-suite, engineering, and procurement levels.
  • Fluency in technical value: high-density GPU environments, liquid cooling, modular power & cooling blocks, prefabrication/off-site integration, and time-to-live economics.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on operator who can open doors, design the deal at startup pace.

Contract Details
  • Type: Contractor / Independent Consultant
  • Compensation: Monthly travel allowance + uncapped, highly competitive success-based commission
  • Start: Immediate


Why Join MatraVolt
  • Scale a solution already validated by the largest AI data center deployment globally.
  • Work where deep-tech, energy, and AI compute converge—on real projects, fast.
  • High autonomy, tight engineering partnership, and a product that wins on speed and cost.
  • Shape the country playbook and help define how Latin America builds AI infrastructure.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Design and Development:

  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.

  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.

  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Company Description

C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm passionate about helping B2B companies overcome capacity and capability gaps in their go-to-market and revenue operations. By building data-driven outbound growth systems, we enable clients to achieve and exceed pipeline and revenue goals without increasing headcount. Our team provides hands-on support and strategic insights across the entire revenue cycle, from offer design and demand generation to CRM integration and reporting. We collaborate with organizations ranging from startups to enterprises, designing scalable and sustainable systems that drive measurable results.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller. The individual in this role will be responsible for identifying potential leads, initiating outbound calls, engaging prospects, and scheduling appointments for the sales team. Additionally, the role involves managing schedules effectively, maintaining detailed records of interactions, and providing excellent customer service to establish trust and build strong client relationships.


The Role

We're looking for an Appointment Setter / Cold Caller to join our team and book qualified meetings for our clients. You'll be on the front lines of outbound, working high-volume calling campaigns across multiple industries. This isn't a role for someone who wants to coast—we run aggressive targets and expect consistent execution.


What You'll Do


Execute + outbound dials daily across client campaigns

Follow proven scripts while adapting to prospect responses in real-time

Book qualified appointments that meet strict ICP criteria

Manage Inbox communication

Collaborate with Campaign Managers and Strategists on targeting and messaging refinements

Hit weekly and monthly meeting quotas consistently



What We're Looking For


Minimum 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting experience in B2B

Proven track record of hitting quota—bring your numbers

Comfortable with rejection and high-volume activity

Clear, professional phone presence

Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional setup

Coachable with a no-excuses attitude toward performance



Bonus Points


Experience in lead gen agencies or sales development roles

Familiarity with dialers, CRMs, and outbound tech stacks

Background calling into professional services, manufacturing, or mid-market B2B



Compensation

Base + performance bonuses tied to meetings booked. Top performers earn significantly more. Details discussed during interviews.


How to Apply

  • Follow our Linkedin Company Page and our Founder Enzo Carasso before applying so we can see that actually read the entire Job Description.
  • Once you've completed the above - send a connection request to Enzo Carasso with a short note on why you're a fit. Include your last 3 months of performance metrics if available-conversion rates, dials per day, meetings booked. No fluff, just results.
